messages.content: يغادر القطار A المدينة X بسرعة 60 كم/ساعة متجها شرقا. يغادر القطار B المدينة Y (التي تبعد 300 كم شرقا) بسرعة 80 كم/ساعة متجها غربا بعد 30 دقيقة. متى وأين يلتقيان؟

<think>Let me solve this step by step.

Train A:
- Leaves city X at 60 km/h heading east
- Starts at time t = 0

Train B:
- Leaves city Y (300 km east of X) at 80 km/h heading west
- Leaves 30 minutes = 0.5 hours after Train A

Let me set up the problem:
- Let t = time after Train A leaves (in hours)
- Train A travels distance: d_A = 60t
- Train B travels for time (t - 0.5) hours (since it leaves 0.5 hours later)
- Train B travels distance: d_B = 80(t - 0.5)

When they meet, the sum of their distances equals 300 km:

60t + 80(t - 0.5) = 300

60t + 80t - 40 = 300
140t = 340
t = 340/140 = 34/14 = 17/7 ≈ 2.4286 hours

So they meet approximately 2.4286 hours after Train A left.

Let me verify:
- Train A travels: 60 × 17/7 = 1020/7 ≈ 145.71 km
- Train B travels for: 17/7 - 0.5 = 17/7 - 1/2 = 34/14 - 7/14 = 27/14 hours
- Train B travels: 80 × 27/14 = 2160/14 = 1080/7 ≈ 154.29 km
- Total: 1020/7 + 1080/7 = 2100/7 = 300 km ✓


- They collide 2 hours 25 minutes 42.9 seconds after Train A departed, which places them roughly 145.7 km east of city X.
